collectionunit.notes: Core acquired as part of the Lake Petén Itzá Scientific Drilling Project (PISDP), International Continental Scientific Drilling Program: http://peten-itza.icdp-online.org. Begin of drilling February 3, 2006, end of drilling March 11, 2006. Cores stored at University of Minnesota at Minneapolis, Department of Earth Sciences, National Lacustrine Core Repository. Core PI-6 is a composite of 3 holes A, B, and C, which provide continuous coverage.

site.sitedescription: The Petén Lake District lies in the Neotropical lowlands of Petén, northern Guatemala. Lake Petén Itzá is one of a series of karstic solution lake basins oriented east–west along en echelon faults. Lake Petén-Itzá lies near the transition from tropical rain forest to the south and tropical seasonal forest to the north.
